run_query_tabular_classification: run the query function to send tabular data to the Hugging Face tabular classification inference API
test_query_function: test the query function with a JSON payload containing tabular input data for classification
build_tabular_inference_request: build a POST request to the Hugging Face inference API with authorization headers and tabular input payload
summarize_query_response: summarize the response content returned by the query function from the HF inference endpoint
review_query_function: review the query function that posts tabular data to the Hugging Face inference API and returns response content
